description: 🔥 Rankify: A Comprehensive Python Toolkit for Retrieval, Re-Ranking, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation 🔥. Our toolkit integrates 40 pre-retrieved benchmark datasets and supports 7+ retrieval techniques, 24+ state-of-the-art Reranking models, and multiple RAG methods.
summary: 🔥 Rankify: A Comprehensive Python Toolkit for Retrieval, Re-Ranking, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation 🔥. Our toolkit integrates 40 pre-retrieved benchmark datasets and supports 7+ retrieval techniques, 24+ state-of-the-art Reranking models, and multiple RAG methods.
